source: Verified research, Cline 4.1.27 / CLI 3.0.75 entry: cline/cline source apps/vscode/src/core/hooks/hook-factory.ts, apps/vscode/src/sdk/hooks-adapter.ts and sdk/packages/core/src/hooks/hook-file-hooks.ts (skeptic: hook_pre_tool, hook_session_start, hook_user_prompt and hook_payload_example corrected, hook_stop confirmed).

selection.sniffNote: The verified research names no Cline hook env var (CLINE_VERSION is read by the CLI process, not documented as set for hooks), so Cline is picked by --agent cline or CI_AGENT.
selection.bareNote: A Cline payload (hookName, nested preToolUse) is not Claude-shaped, so with no flag the deny is exit 2 on stderr. Cline's VS Code adapter fails open on a non-zero exit with no JSON, so the installer must render --agent cline.

deny.source: Cline hook_pre_tool (skeptic: contract right): print {cancel: true, errorMessage}; valid JSON is honoured whatever the exit code.

context.source: Cline hook_session_start: in the VS Code extension the TaskStart contextModification is injected (skeptic: once per submitted turn).

PreToolUse.source: Cline hook_payload_example: the VS Code extension payload assembled from hook-factory.ts completeParams() and hooks-adapter.ts beforeTool; parameters values are strings, so commands is a JSON-encoded array

PostToolUse.source: Cline hook_post_tool: the payload adds postToolUse {toolName, parameters, result, success, executionTimeMs}

UserPromptSubmit.source: Cline hook_user_prompt: userPromptSubmit {prompt, attachments[]} (skeptic: attachments is always [])

SessionStart.source: Cline hook_session_start: TaskStart is the nearest match; hooks-adapter.ts runTaskStart builds taskStart {taskMetadata {taskId, ulid: "", initialTask}}

absent.Stop: Cline hook_stop (skeptic: confirmed): TaskComplete and TaskCancel are notification-only and cannot re-prompt, so the Stop hooks are not wired on Cline.
absent.SessionEnd: Cline hook_stop: SessionShutdown is CLI/SDK only and the VS Code adapter does not wire it, so session.mjs is not wired to a session end on Cline.
